tagline: A growing Asian side business and lifestyle hub — the Kozyatağı metro station connects a mix of tech offices, malls, and a comfortable residential scene.

items.name: Capacity AVM Cafés
items.description: Multiple café options in the Capacity shopping centre near Kozyatağı metro. Convenient and reliable.

items.name: Kozyatağı Restoranları
items.description: A growing restaurant scene around the metro station with a mix of local and international options.

tips: Kozyatağı is on the M4 metro line — good connections to Kadıköy, Ataşehir, and the airport.
A practical residential and business area. Better connected than it is characterful.
Housing is more affordable than Göztepe or Caddebostan with similar metro access.
The Capacity shopping centre is the main commercial hub of the area.
